findings.evidence: Spectrum.lean:199 `namespace LinearMap.IsSymmetric` holds `eigenvectorSpan`, `eigenvectorBasis_mem_eigenvectorSpan_iff`, `map_eigenvectorSpan_le`, all taking `(hT : T.IsSymmetric)` first.
findings.fix: Move it to `namespace LinearMap.IsSymmetric` (as `LinearMap.IsSymmetric.isOrderedEigenframe_eigenvectorBasis`), matching the sibling `eigenvectorSpan` API.
findings.issue: `isOrderedEigenframe_eigenvectorBasis (hT : T.IsSymmetric) ...` takes a Mathlib `LinearMap.IsSymmetric` proof as its first explicit argument but sits in `TauCeti`, so `hT.isOrderedEigenframe_eigenvectorBasis` does not elaborate.

findings.fix: Move it to `LinearMap.IsSymmetric.correspondingEigenblocks_eigenvectorBasis` so `hT.correspondingEigenblocks_eigenvectorBasis hS hn e` works.
findings.issue: Same problem for `correspondingEigenblocks_eigenvectorBasis (hT : T.IsSymmetric) (hS : S.IsSymmetric) ...`: its first explicit argument is a `LinearMap.IsSymmetric` proof, but it is filed under `TauCeti`.

findings.evidence: Line 41 `structure IsEigenFamily`, line 99 `def IsOrderedEigenframe`, file path `Spectral/EigenFrame.lean`; Mathlib writes `eigenspace` and `eigenvectorBasis` as single words.
findings.fix: Use the one-word form throughout, as Mathlib does for `eigenspace` and `eigenvectorBasis`: `IsEigenfamily` and `Eigenframe.lean`.
findings.issue: Inconsistent word split in one API: `IsEigenFamily` (two words) next to `IsOrderedEigenframe` (one word), and the file is `EigenFrame.lean` (two words). Users can't guess one name from the other.

summary: Two lemmas whose first explicit argument is `hT : T.IsSymmetric` are in `TauCeti` instead of `LinearMap.IsSymmetric`, against the namespace rule and the adjacent `eigenvectorSpan` API. The new API also splits Eigenframe/EigenFamily inconsistently.
